title: Who works at Exponent today, by specialty
what: A live census of Exponent's ~1,000 consultants, grouped by their practice area (the field they consult in).
how: Exponent's own website has a searchable staff directory. We queried the same search system the website itself uses and counted everyone listed, along with the practice area shown on each profile.
thesis: The MIX of specialties shows where Exponent is betting: large and growing practices in batteries/thermal sciences, chemical regulation, and data/computer science are exactly the areas tied to EV fires, PFAS regulation, and AI-era product risk - the demand drivers the buy thesis leans on.
caveats: This is the public directory; the company's official headcount (in its 10-K annual report) also counts support staff, so the two numbers won't match exactly.
A practice area label is how Exponent categorizes itself - some consultants work across several areas.
